87	## 1. Reliability Diagram（校准图）
88	
89	**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。
90	
91	```python
92	def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
93	                              label='', color='#0072B2',
94	                              title='Reliability Diagram',
95	                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
96	    """
97	    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
98	    """
99	    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
100	    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []
101	
102	    for i in range(n_bins):
103	        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
104	        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
105	        if mask.sum() > 0:
106	            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
107	            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
108	            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
109	        else:
110	            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
111	            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
112	            bin_counts.append(0)
113	
114	    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
115	    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)
116	
117	    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
118	        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
119	        sharex=True
120	    )
121	
122	    # 主图：gaps
123	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
124	                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
125	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
126	                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
127	    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
128	    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
129	    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
130	    ax_main.set_title(title)
131	    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
132	    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)
133	
134	    # ECE annotation
135	    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
136	                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
137	    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
138	                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
139	                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))
140	
141	    # 直方图（样本密度）
142	    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
143	                color=color, alpha=0.5)
144	    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
145	    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')
146	
147	    plt.tight_layout()
148	    plt.savefig(outpath)
149	    plt.close()
150	    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
151	```

172	## 2. ECE Heatmap（方法 × 数据集 ΔECE）
173	
174	**用途**：Main Results Table 的可视化版本，颜色 = ΔECE（红=恶化，蓝=改善）。
175	
176	```python
177	def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
178	                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
179	                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
180	    """
181	    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
182	    """
183	    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
184	
185	    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))
186	
187	    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
188	    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
189	    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
190	    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r
191	
192	    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')
193	
194	    # 数值标注
195	    for i in range(len(methods)):
196	        for j in range(len(datasets)):
197	            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
198	            if not np.isnan(val):
199	                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
200	                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
201	                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
202	                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')
203	
204	    ax.set_xticks(range(len(datasets)))
205	    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
206	    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
207	    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
208	    ax.set_title(title)
209	
210	    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
211	    cbar.set_label('ΔECE (quantized − FP16)')
212	    cbar.ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.8)
213	
214	    plt.tight_layout()
215	    plt.savefig(outpath)
216	    plt.close()
217	    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
218	```

368	### Pattern E：Wilson Binomial CI
369	
370	```python
371	def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
372	    if n == 0: return 0, 0
373	    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
374	    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
375	    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
376	    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)
377	
378	# 用法
379	lo, hi = wilson_ci(accuracy, n)
380	ax.errorbar(x, accuracy*100, yerr=[[accuracy*100 - lo*100], [hi*100 - accuracy*100]],
381	            fmt='o', capsize=4, capthick=0.8, elinewidth=0.8,
382	            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0)
383	```

## 1. Reliability Diagram（校准图）

**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。

```python
def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
                              label='', color='#0072B2',
                              title='Reliability Diagram',
                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
    """
    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
    """
    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []

    for i in range(n_bins):
        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
        if mask.sum() > 0:
            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
        else:
            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
            bin_counts.append(0)

    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)

    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
        sharex=True
    )

    # 主图：gaps
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
    ax_main.set_title(title)
    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    # ECE annotation
    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

    # 直方图（样本密度）
    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.5)
    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

## 2. ECE Heatmap（方法 × 数据集 ΔECE）

**用途**：Main Results Table 的可视化版本，颜色 = ΔECE（红=恶化，蓝=改善）。

```python
def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
    """
    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
    """
    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))

    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r

    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')

    # 数值标注
    for i in range(len(methods)):
        for j in range(len(datasets)):
            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(datasets)))
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
    ax.set_title(title)

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
    cbar.set_label('ΔECE (quantized − FP16)')
    cbar.ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.8)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

def plot_tstar_scatter(tstar_data, outpath='tstar_scatter.pdf'):

    DATASETS = ['HellaSwag', 'ARC-C', 'MMLU', 'BoolQ', 'TruthfulQA', 'NQ-Open']

        (5, 10.5, '#FDF2F8', 'Regime C\n(T*≥5)'),

                color='gray', zorder=1)

    model_colors = [COLORS.get(m.split('-')[0].lower(), '#333333') for m in MODELS]

    x = np.arange(len(DATASETS))
    for mi, (model, color) in enumerate(zip(MODELS, model_colors)):

        ax.plot(x, y, 'o-', color=color, label=model,

    ax.set_xticks(x)

    ax.set_ylim(0, 10.5)

    ax.axhline(1, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5)
    ax.axhline(5, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5)
    ax.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9, ncol=2)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, axis='y', zorder=1)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')

### Pattern A：Regime Background Bands

import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
# 横向 regime bands
REGIME_BANDS = [(0, 1, '#EBF5FB', 'Regime A'),
                (1, 5, '#EAFAF1', 'Regime B'),

### Pattern B：发散面积 fill_between

```python
# alpha 极低（0.06）：不抢眼但有面积
ax.fill_between(x_range, curve_upper, curve_lower,
                alpha=0.06, color='#555555', zorder=1, label='_nolegend_')
```

### Pattern C：参考线锚定真实值

```python
ax.axhline(y=actual_value, color=color, linestyle=':',
           linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)
t = ax.text(x_pos, actual_value + 1, 'actual W3A16',
            fontsize=7, color=color, alpha=0.5, ha='center')
t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])
```

### Pattern D：信息层级 marker（hollow vs solid by sample size）

```python
# 实心 = n >= 50, 空心带 n 标注 = n < 50
solid_mask = [n >= 50 for n in n_vals]
for x, y, n, solid in zip(xs, ys, n_vals, solid_mask):
    if solid:
        ax.plot(x, y, marker=marker, color=color, markersize=6,
                markerfacecolor=color, markeredgewidth=0)
    else:
        ax.plot(x, y, marker=marker, color=color, markersize=6,
                markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor=color,
                markeredgewidth=1.2, zorder=4)
        ax.annotate(f'n={n}', (x, y), textcoords='offset points',
                    xytext=(0, 7), fontsize=5, color=color,
                    ha='center', fontstyle='italic')
```

### Pattern E：Wilson Binomial CI

```python
def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0: return 0, 0
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)

# 用法
lo, hi = wilson_ci(accuracy, n)
ax.errorbar(x, accuracy*100, yerr=[[accuracy*100 - lo*100], [hi*100 - accuracy*100]],
            fmt='o', capsize=4, capthick=0.8, elinewidth=0.8,
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0)
```

### Pattern F：Per-label offset dict（防标注重叠）

```python
label_offsets = {
    'Qwen3-8B':  (6, -12),
    'Qwen3-4B':  (-55, 4),
    'Llama-8B':  (6, 6),
}
for name, (x, y) in data.items():
    ox, oy = label_offsets.get(name, (6, 6))
    ax.annotate(name, (x, y), xytext=(ox, oy),
                textcoords='offset points', fontsize=7,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='gray',
                                lw=0.4) if abs(ox) > 20 else None)
```

### Pattern G：Hatching 加分类维度

```python
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
for is_collapse, bar in zip(collapse_flags, bars):
    if is_collapse:
        bar.set_hatch('///')
        bar.set_alpha(0.7)
# Legend 加 hatching 说明
legend_patch = Patch(facecolor='gray', hatch='///', alpha=0.7, label='Collapse')
ax.legend(handles=[legend_patch], loc='lower right')
```

### Pattern H：Multi-panel 非对称布局

```python
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.5, 3.2),
                          gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.4, 1]})
# axes[0] 是主面板（1.4x 宽），axes[1] 副面板
# 给每个 panel 写 insight subtitle
axes[0].set_title('(a) Quantization shifts confidence', fontsize=9, pad=6)
axes[1].set_title('(b) Temperature scaling recovers it', fontsize=9, pad=6)
```

### Pattern I：Broken axis（异常值或对数 0）

```python
d = 0.012  # 斜线长度
kwargs = dict(transform=ax.transAxes, color='black',
              clip_on=False, linewidth=0.6)
ax.plot((1-d, 1+d), (-d, +d), **kwargs)
ax.plot((1-d, 1+d), (1-d, 1+d), **kwargs)
```

### Pattern J：Path-effect 文字描边

```python
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
t = ax.text(x, y, 'label', fontsize=8, color='red')
t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])
```

### Pattern K：Concept curve（合成轨迹建立直觉）

```python
# 完全不基于实验数据的概念曲线
x = np.linspace(0, 1, 100)
trajectory = baseline * (1 - np.cos(np.pi * x)) / 2
ax.plot(x, trajectory, color='#0072B2', linewidth=2,
        solid_capstyle='round', label='Theoretical trajectory')

# 关键节点用 insight 标注
ax.annotate('gap eliminated', xy=(1.0, final_y),
            xytext=(0.7, final_y - 5), color='#388E3C',
            fontstyle='italic', fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#388E3C', lw=0.8))
```

### Pattern L：Forest Plot（meta-analysis 风格）

```python
# 3-column GridSpec: label | CI plot | inline stats
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7, 3.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(1, 3, width_ratios=[0.8, 2, 1.2], wspace=0.1)
ax_label = fig.add_subplot(gs[0]); ax_label.axis('off')
ax_main = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax_stat = fig.add_subplot(gs[2]); ax_stat.axis('off')

# 等价带（半透明 axvspan）
ax_main.axvspan(-1, 1, alpha=0.1, color='gray', label='±1pp equivalence')

# 每行：dot + horizontal CI line
for i, (name, mean, lo, hi, pval) in enumerate(rows):
    ax_label.text(0.5, i, name, fontsize=9, va='center', ha='center')
    ax_main.plot([lo, hi], [i, i], color='black', linewidth=1)
    ax_main.plot(mean, i, 'D', color='#0072B2', markersize=7)
    ax_stat.text(0.5, i, f'{mean:+.2f} [{lo:+.2f}, {hi:+.2f}]  p={pval:.3f}',
                 fontsize=8, va='center', ha='center', family='monospace')

ax_main.axvline(0, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.6)
ax_main.invert_yaxis()
```

31	## L0 学习同行（设计前的功课）
32	
33	你的子领域里，**最被引用、最被记住的论文是怎么画图的？** 在动笔之前花点时间去看一眼——这个动作的回报远高于读完下面的 L1-L4。
34	
35	### 为什么这一步是重要的
36	
37	- 同领域读者已经被这些论文的视觉语言"训练"过——遵循惯例 = 降低读者认知负担
38	- 顶会论文经历过 reviewer 严苛审查，能登出来的图基本说明它的 narrative 设计是被接受的
39	- 抽象原则告诉你"用 fill_between 表示发散"，但好论文告诉你"在这种数据上，发散到底应该画多淡才合适"
40	- 一个领域往往有它特有的图表惯例（如校准研究的 reliability diagram、scaling 研究的 log-log curve、RL 的 learning curve with seed bands），不看就不会用
41	
42	### 什么时候值得投入
43	
44	判断权交给你。一些可参考的信号：
45	
46	- **值得多花时间**：会决定论文成败的图（hero figure、main result、新颖的实验类型）
47	- **不太值得**：常规 supplementary 图、loss curve 这类标准化已经很高的图
48	- **强烈建议看**：你打算画一种自己不熟悉的图，或者数据形态是这个领域少见的
49	
50	### 怎么看
51	
52	工具：`paper-image-extractor` skill 可以从 arXiv source 或 PDF 提取参考论文里的 figure。你已经有 `literature_map.yaml` 里的论文清单作为起点。
53	
54	看的时候问自己（不是机械检查清单，是真的去理解）：
55	
56	- 这张图回答了什么问题？读者一眼能 get 到吗？
57	- 它用了哪些叙事层（background band / 参考线 / 概念曲线 / fill 区域）？这些层在我的数据上有对应物吗？
58	- 它的颜色和 marker 怎么承载语义？我的图能不能借鉴这套映射？
59	- 它有什么是这篇论文特有的（与他们的具体数据 / claim 绑死）？这些不要照搬。
60	- 如果让我重画它的图，我会怎么改？为什么作者没这么做？
61	
62	### 怎么把学到的传下去
63	
64	把你看完后的判断**直接写进对应 fig 的 `design_notes`**，用人话不用模板。例子：
65	
66	```yaml
67	design_notes:
68	  - "学 GPTQ Fig 4：用 log-scale bit-width + dashed FP16 baseline + 不同 marker shape 分模型族"
69	  - "Pattern A（regime band）划分 in-domain / OOD 两段"
70	  - "AWQ Fig 2 那种 hatching 区分 outlier 不适用我们的数据，跳过"
71	```
72	
73	Worker 拿到这种 design_notes 就知道既要参考 GPTQ 的 layout 又要用 Pattern A，能直接落实成代码。
74	
75	### 边界
76	
77	- 不要复刻，要消化。直接抄一张图既没用（数据不一样）也有风险（与他们的 claim 强绑定）
78	- 不要看太多。3 张就够，多了 Paper Agent 会陷入"该听谁的"
79	- 看不到原图（提取失败 / arXiv 无 source）就跳过，不要在这里卡住流程
80	
81	---
82	
83	## L1 防丑原则（底线，不可违反）
84	
85	来自 Tufte 和 Luís Cruz 16 条公认规范。Agent 默认遵守，无需逐条思考。
86	
87	1. **Self-explanatory** — 不看正文就能看懂：title/caption + 所有轴有 label + 单位
88	2. **去 chartjunk** — 不要 3D、不要背景框、不要无意义网格、不要 dual y-axis、不要 pie/donut chart
89	3. **直接标注 > Legend** — 能直接标在曲线/柱旁就不用 legend；legend 必要时不遮数据
90	4. **颜色/形状/纹理只用于 data variation** — 不用颜色装饰，不用相同颜色表示不同数据
91	5. **Meaningful baseline** — bar chart 必须从 0 起；scatter 可以非 0
92	6. **文字水平** — label 不要旋转/垂直；类别名太长 → 用 horizontal bar chart
93	7. **Sort for comparison** — 柱状图按数值排序，便于对比（除非有自然顺序如时间）
94	8. **字号一致** — 用 mm 计算 figsize（`ONE_MM = 1/25.4`），不在 LaTeX 里 `\includegraphics[scale=...]` resize
95	9. **色盲友好** — 默认 Okabe-Ito；红/绿区分时变 saturation；考虑 grayscale 打印
96	10. **Bold 只用于强调** — 不要全图加粗；highlight 留给 takeaway
97	11. **Line plot 只用于有序数据** — 类别变量用 bar
98	12. **单 x 单 y 轴** — 必须双轴时改成 multi-panel
99	13. **300 DPI、PDF 矢量、savefig.bbox=tight、去掉 top/right spines**
100	
101	---
102	
103	## L2 叙事原则（让图变成论证）
104	
105	L1 让图"不丑"，L2 让图"有说服力"。这一层是 Agent 自主画图时最容易缺失的。
106	
107	### 原则 1：每张图回答一个明确问题
108	
109	动笔前用一句话写下："This figure shows that ___."
110	
111	如果写不出来，就不要画。如果写出来的 takeaway 不是论文的 claim，就要重新设计。
112	
113	**反例**：`"Accuracy across methods"` — 这只是个标题，不是问题
114	**正例**：`"FP16 baseline 在小模型上比量化版高 5pp，但 70B 模型上差距消失"` — 这是一张图要说服读者相信的事
115	
116	`visualization_plan.{fig_id}.narrative_intent` 字段写这一句。
117	
118	### 原则 2：颜色绑定语义而非数据顺序
119	
120	错的做法：`colors = ['blue', 'orange', 'green', 'red']` 按数据顺序分配。
121	对的做法：`BN → 蓝色（始终）`、`non-BN → 橙色（始终）`、`collapse/danger → vermillion (#D55E00)`、`safe/baseline → blue (#0072B2)`。
122	
123	整篇论文 6 张图，BN 永远蓝、collapse 永远红——零认知负担，读者一眼建立映射。
124	
125	### 原则 3：信息层级用 visual variable 表达
126	
127	数据的"质量"和"分类"应该可见，不应该藏在 caption 里：
128	
129	| 信息 | Visual 表达 |
130	|------|------------|
131	| n < 50 低置信度点 | hollow marker + 标注 `n=` |
132	| Out-of-sample / pending 数据 | hollow + 不同 marker shape（如 diamond）+ "OOS" label |
133	| Collapse / 异常类别 | hatching（斜线填充）|
134	| 主结果 vs 次要结果 | 主用饱和色，次要用 muted 色或 alpha |
135	
136	### 原则 4：加叙事层，不只画数据
137	
138	数据是图的基础，叙事层是让读者"读懂"的关键。常见叙事层：
139	
140	- **Background bands** — `axhspan/axvspan` 标定性区域（"collapse zone"、"safe zone"、"Regime A/B/C"）
141	- **Fill_between** — 显示两条曲线发散区域（alpha 极低如 0.06，不抢眼但有面积）
142	- **Reference lines** — 锚定真实值（如 dashed line 标"actual W3A16 accuracy"）
143	- **Equivalence band** — `axvspan` gradient fade 标 +/-1pp 等价区间
144	- **Concept curve** — 完全合成的曲线（如 cosine trajectory）建立理论直觉
145	
146	这些都不来自数据，但帮读者"看到"数据想说什么。
147	
148	### 原则 5：Subtitle / panel label 写 insight 不写描述
149	
150	错：`"Layer 6 comparison across three models"`
151	对：`"Same relative position, opposite function"`
152	
153	错：`"Reliability diagram"`
154	对：`"Quantization shifts confidence but not accuracy"`
155	
156	副标题是免费的 takeaway，不要浪费。
157	
158	### 原则 6：Multi-panel 每个面板独立回答一个 sub-question
159	
160	不要做"主图 + 装饰小图"。每个 panel 必须有独立的信息价值。
161	
162	如果一个 panel 想不出独立的问题，要么删掉，要么合并到主 panel。
163	
164	布局上：非对称比例（如 1.4:1）让视觉重心对齐叙事重心。
165	
166	### 原则 7：Hero figure 默认要 2-3 轮迭代
167	
168	第一版画出来基本不能直接用。计划好预算：先确定数据和布局，再调样式标注，最后 polish。不要指望一次到位。
169	
170	---
171	
172	## L3 Pattern 库（按 `design_notes` 选用）
173	
174	按"图要回答的问题"选 pattern。每个 pattern 给出**何时用**、**怎么用**（具体代码或 matplotlib API）。
175	
176	### Pattern A：定性区域 / regime bands
177	
178	**何时用**：x 或 y 轴有自然分段（regime、phase、severity tier）。
179	
180	```python
181	# horizontal bands
182	for lo, hi, color, label in [(0, 1, '#EBF5FB', 'Regime A'), (1, 5, '#EAFAF1', 'Regime B')]:
183	    ax.axhspan(lo, hi, alpha=0.25, color=color, zorder=0)
184	    ax.text(x_label_pos, (lo+hi)/2, label, va='center', fontsize=9, color='gray')
185	
186	# 单一 collapse zone
187	ax.axhspan(-5, 5, color='#FDEDEC', alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
188	ax.text(0.02, 2.5, 'collapse zone', fontsize=8, color='#ccaaaa', fontstyle='italic')
189	```
190	
191	### Pattern B：发散面积 fill_between
192	
193	**何时用**：两组数据从某点开始发散，想让"发散程度"可见。
194	
195	```python
196	# alpha 0.06 极淡，不抢眼但有面积
197	ax.fill_between(x_range, curve_high, curve_low, alpha=0.06, color='#555555', zorder=1)
198	```
199	
200	### Pattern C：参考线锚定真实值
201	
202	**何时用**：合成 / 缩放后的 x 轴需要锚定到真实物理量。
203	
204	```python
205	ax.axhline(y=actual_value, color=color, linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.3)
206	t = ax.text(x_pos, actual_value+1, 'actual W3A16', fontsize=7, color=color, alpha=0.5)
207	t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])  # 防遮挡
208	```
209	
210	### Pattern D：信息层级 marker（hollow vs solid）
211	
212	**何时用**：同一图中有不同置信度 / OOS / pending 数据。
213	
214	```python
215	# 实心 = n >= 50, 空心 = n < 50
216	if n < 50:
217	    ax.plot(x, y, marker='o', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor=color,
218	            markeredgewidth=1.2, markersize=6)
219	    ax.annotate(f'n={n}', (x, y), xytext=(0, 7), textcoords='offset points',
220	                fontsize=5, color=color, fontstyle='italic')
221	```
222	
223	### Pattern E：Wilson CI / bootstrap 不确定性
224	
225	**何时用**：accuracy / proportion 数据需要置信区间。
226	
227	```python
228	def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
229	    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
230	    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
231	    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
232	    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)
233	```
234	
235	### Pattern F：Per-label offset dict（解决标注重叠）
236	
237	**何时用**：scatter 上多个点需要标注且自动布局重叠。
238	
239	```python
240	label_offsets = {
241	    'Qwen3-8B':  (6, -12),   # 向下避让
242	    'Qwen3-4B':  (-55, 4),   # 向左避让
243	    'Llama-8B':  (6, 6),
244	}
245	for name, (x, y) in data.items():
246	    ox, oy = label_offsets.get(name, (6, 6))
247	    ax.annotate(name, (x, y), xytext=(ox, oy), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=7)
248	```
249	
250	### Pattern G：Hatching 加分类维度
251	
252	**何时用**：已用颜色表示一个维度，再加一个二元维度（如 collapse vs not）。
253	
254	```python
255	for is_collapse, bar in zip(collapse_flags, bars):
256	    if is_collapse:
257	        bar.set_hatch('///')
258	        bar.set_alpha(0.7)
259	```
260	
261	### Pattern H：Multi-panel 非对称布局
262	
263	**何时用**：主图 + 辅助 panel；或两个等重要 panel 但视觉重心需要倾斜。
264	
265	```python
266	fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.5, 3.2),
267	                          gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.4, 1]})
268	# 主面板 1.4x 宽，副面板 1x；视觉重心在左
269	```
270	
271	### Pattern I：Broken axis（异常值或对数 0）
272	
273	**何时用**：数据范围跨度大，或对数轴需要表示 0。
274	
275	```python
276	d = 0.012
277	kwargs = dict(transform=ax.transAxes, color='black', clip_on=False, linewidth=0.6)
278	ax.plot((1-d, 1+d), (-d, +d), **kwargs)  # 右下角斜线
279	ax.plot((1-d, 1+d), (1-d, 1+d), **kwargs)  # 右上角斜线
280	```
281	
282	### Pattern J：Path-effect 文字描边
283	
284	**何时用**：标注必须放在数据点 / colored region 上方。
285	
286	```python
287	import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
288	t = ax.text(x, y, 'label', fontsize=8, color='red')
289	t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])
290	```
291	
292	### Pattern K：Concept curve（建立直觉）
293	
294	**何时用**：论文核心 claim 是定性现象，需要先让读者理解理论预期。
295	
296	```python
297	# 完全合成的 cosine trajectory，不是实验数据
298	x = np.linspace(0, 1, 100)
299	trajectory = baseline * (1 - np.cos(np.pi * x)) / 2
300	ax.plot(x, trajectory, linewidth=2, solid_capstyle='round')
301	ax.annotate('gap eliminated', (1.0, final_y), color='#388E3C',
302	            fontstyle='italic', fontsize=9)
303	```
304	
305	### Pattern L：Forest plot（meta-analysis 风格）
306	
307	**何时用**：多个子条件的 effect size + CI 对比，加 inline 统计数字。
308	
309	3-column GridSpec：(1) 标签 (2) CI 区间图 (3) 统计数字（mean, CI, p-value）
310	
311	每行：dot + horizontal line(CI) + 数字 inline。等价带用半透明 axvspan。
312	
313	---
314	
315	## L4 工具路由 + 模板
316	
317	### 路由规则
318	
319	| 场景 | 工具 | 原因 |
320	|------|------|------|
321	| 概念图（架构图、流程图、framework 示意） | **PaperBanana（Gemini）** | matplotlib 不擅长 |
322	| 统计图（scatter、bar、line、heatmap、forest） | **matplotlib** | 确定性、可控 |
323	| 探索性图，不确定 layout | **PaperBanana** | LLM 多轮迭代试 |
324	| 离线 / 无 GOOGLE_API_KEY | **matplotlib** | 不依赖外部 API |
325	
326	项目级偏好：`config/projects/{name}.yaml` 的 `visualization.preferred_tool` 可覆盖。
327	
328	### Matplotlib 通用样式（rcParams 标准）
329	
330	```python
331	import matplotlib
332	matplotlib.use('Agg')
333	import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
334	import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
335	import numpy as np
336	
337	plt.rcParams.update({
338	    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
339	    'font.size': 11, 'axes.titlesize': 13, 'axes.labelsize': 12,
340	    'xtick.labelsize': 10, 'ytick.labelsize': 10, 'legend.fontsize': 10,
341	    'figure.dpi': 300, 'savefig.dpi': 300,
342	    'savefig.bbox': 'tight', 'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
343	    'axes.spines.top': False, 'axes.spines.right': False,
344	    'pdf.fonttype': 42, 'ps.fonttype': 42,  # TrueType 嵌入
345	    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
346	})
347	
348	# 色盲友好语义色板（Okabe-Ito）
349	SEMANTIC_COLORS = {
350	    'baseline':   '#0072B2',  # blue - safe / mild
351	    'treatment':  '#E69F00',  # orange - intervention
352	    'collapse':   '#D55E00',  # vermillion - danger / catastrophic
353	    'safe':       '#009E73',  # green - good outcome
354	    'neutral':    '#999999',  # gray - reference / control
355	}
356	```
357	
358	### 常用模板（仅作起点，需按 narrative_intent 改造）
359	
360	详细执行模板见 `skills/global/draw-paper-figure.skill.md`：
361	- Reliability Diagram（校准图）
362	- ECE Heatmap（方法 × 数据集 ΔECE）
363	- T* Scatter Plot（任务 Regime 可视化）
364	
365	**重要**：这些模板是起点不是终点。每张图根据 `narrative_intent` 必须加 L3 中的相关 pattern，不能直接套用。
366	
367	### 主图（Figure 1）特别提示
368	
369	大多数 ML 论文的 Figure 1 是概念图/架构图/方法概览——正是 PaperBanana 的强项。除非 Figure 1 是纯数值结果对比（如 Pareto frontier），否则优先用 PaperBanana。Figure 1 的 `narrative_intent` 必须与 `writing_plan.yaml` 的 `meta.core_claim` 直接关联。
370	
371	### PaperBanana 用法
372	
373	见 `skills/global/paper-banana.skill.md`。意图描述时直接引用 `narrative_intent`，并把 L3 中的 pattern 名写进 intent（如 "with collapse zone background band, hollow markers for n<50"）。
374	
375	---
376	
377	## 给 Paper Agent 的填写规则
378	
379	规划 `visualization_plan` 时，对每张图填：
380	
381	```yaml
382	- fig_id: fig2_main_result
383	  type: statistical
384	  tool: matplotlib
385	  data_source: "registry: exp_001, exp_002"
386	  placement: experiments
387	
388	  # 新字段（必填）
389	  narrative_intent: "Quantized models match FP16 on accuracy but degrade calibration; ECE gap widens with bits→2."
390	  design_notes:
391	    - "Pattern A: regime bands for bits=8/4/3"
392	    - "Pattern C: dashed line for FP16 ECE baseline"
393	    - "Pattern D: hollow markers for n<50 data points"
394	
395	  aspect_ratio: "4:3"
396	```
397	
398	`narrative_intent`：一句话，主动语态，描述读者应该相信的事。
399	
400	`design_notes`：从 L3 选 0-4 个 pattern，给出选用理由。可以为空（说明默认模板足够）。
401	
402	---
403	
404	## 提交前 Checklist
405	
406	L1 部分（防丑底线）：
407	- [ ] 所有轴有 label + 单位
408	- [ ] 无 dual y-axis、无 3D、无 pie
409	- [ ] 颜色绑定语义、色盲友好
410	- [ ] Bar chart 从 0 起（如有）
411	- [ ] 字号 ≥ 10pt（缩到 column width 后仍可读）
412	- [ ] PDF 矢量、300 DPI
413	
414	L2 部分（叙事强度）：
415	- [ ] 能用一句话写出 figure takeaway（应等于 `narrative_intent`）
416	- [ ] Subtitle / panel label 是 insight，不是描述
417	- [ ] 数据质量差异在视觉上可见（n、OOS、pending 等）
418	- [ ] 至少考虑过是否需要 background band / fill_between / reference line（不一定要加）
419

name: paper-visualization

# Paper Visualization — 学术图表设计与生成

> **核心理念**：好图不是"画得对"，是"回答一个问题"。每张图动笔前先问：**这张图要让读者看到什么？**

本 skill 分五层：

- **L0 学习同行** — 设计前看几张优秀同类型论文图，比读任何原则都有效
- **L1 防丑原则** — 底线，所有图必须遵守
- **L2 叙事原则** — 让图有说服力（区分"数据图"和"论证图"）
- **L3 Pattern 库** — 具体技法目录，按 `design_notes` 选用
- **L4 工具路由 + 模板** — paperbanana vs matplotlib，常用统计图模板

---

## L0 学习同行（设计前的功课）

你的子领域里，**最被引用、最被记住的论文是怎么画图的？** 在动笔之前花点时间去看一眼——这个动作的回报远高于读完下面的 L1-L4。

### 为什么这一步是重要的

- 同领域读者已经被这些论文的视觉语言"训练"过——遵循惯例 = 降低读者认知负担
- 顶会论文经历过 reviewer 严苛审查，能登出来的图基本说明它的 narrative 设计是被接受的
- 抽象原则告诉你"用 fill_between 表示发散"，但好论文告诉你"在这种数据上，发散到底应该画多淡才合适"
- 一个领域往往有它特有的图表惯例（如校准研究的 reliability diagram、scaling 研究的 log-log curve、RL 的 learning curve with seed bands），不看就不会用

### 什么时候值得投入

判断权交给你。一些可参考的信号：

- **值得多花时间**：会决定论文成败的图（hero figure、main result、新颖的实验类型）
- **不太值得**：常规 supplementary 图、loss curve 这类标准化已经很高的图
- **强烈建议看**：你打算画一种自己不熟悉的图，或者数据形态是这个领域少见的

### 怎么看

工具：`paper-image-extractor` skill 可以从 arXiv source 或 PDF 提取参考论文里的 figure。你已经有 `literature_map.yaml` 里的论文清单作为起点。

看的时候问自己（不是机械检查清单，是真的去理解）：

- 这张图回答了什么问题？读者一眼能 get 到吗？
- 它用了哪些叙事层（background band / 参考线 / 概念曲线 / fill 区域）？这些层在我的数据上有对应物吗？
- 它的颜色和 marker 怎么承载语义？我的图能不能借鉴这套映射？
- 它有什么是这篇论文特有的（与他们的具体数据 / claim 绑死）？这些不要照搬。
- 如果让我重画它的图，我会怎么改？为什么作者没这么做？

### 怎么把学到的传下去

把你看完后的判断**直接写进对应 fig 的 `design_notes`**，用人话不用模板。例子：

```yaml
design_notes:
  - "学 GPTQ Fig 4：用 log-scale bit-width + dashed FP16 baseline + 不同 marker shape 分模型族"
  - "Pattern A（regime band）划分 in-domain / OOD 两段"
  - "AWQ Fig 2 那种 hatching 区分 outlier 不适用我们的数据，跳过"
```

Worker 拿到这种 design_notes 就知道既要参考 GPTQ 的 layout 又要用 Pattern A，能直接落实成代码。

### 边界

- 不要复刻，要消化。直接抄一张图既没用（数据不一样）也有风险（与他们的 claim 强绑定）
- 不要看太多。3 张就够，多了 Paper Agent 会陷入"该听谁的"
- 看不到原图（提取失败 / arXiv 无 source）就跳过，不要在这里卡住流程

---

## L1 防丑原则（底线，不可违反）

来自 Tufte 和 Luís Cruz 16 条公认规范。Agent 默认遵守，无需逐条思考。

1. **Self-explanatory** — 不看正文就能看懂：title/caption + 所有轴有 label + 单位
2. **去 chartjunk** — 不要 3D、不要背景框、不要无意义网格、不要 dual y-axis、不要 pie/donut chart
3. **直接标注 > Legend** — 能直接标在曲线/柱旁就不用 legend；legend 必要时不遮数据
4. **颜色/形状/纹理只用于 data variation** — 不用颜色装饰，不用相同颜色表示不同数据
5. **Meaningful baseline** — bar chart 必须从 0 起；scatter 可以非 0
6. **文字水平** — label 不要旋转/垂直；类别名太长 → 用 horizontal bar chart
7. **Sort for comparison** — 柱状图按数值排序，便于对比（除非有自然顺序如时间）
8. **字号一致** — 用 mm 计算 figsize（`ONE_MM = 1/25.4`），不在 LaTeX 里 `\includegraphics[scale=...]` resize
9. **色盲友好** — 默认 Okabe-Ito；红/绿区分时变 saturation；考虑 grayscale 打印
10. **Bold 只用于强调** — 不要全图加粗；highlight 留给 takeaway
11. **Line plot 只用于有序数据** — 类别变量用 bar
12. **单 x 单 y 轴** — 必须双轴时改成 multi-panel
13. **300 DPI、PDF 矢量、savefig.bbox=tight、去掉 top/right spines**

---

## L2 叙事原则（让图变成论证）

L1 让图"不丑"，L2 让图"有说服力"。这一层是 Agent 自主画图时最容易缺失的。

### 原则 1：每张图回答一个明确问题

动笔前用一句话写下："This figure shows that ___."

如果写不出来，就不要画。如果写出来的 takeaway 不是论文的 claim，就要重新设计。

**反例**：`"Accuracy across methods"` — 这只是个标题，不是问题
**正例**：`"FP16 baseline 在小模型上比量化版高 5pp，但 70B 模型上差距消失"` — 这是一张图要说服读者相信的事

`visualization_plan.{fig_id}.narrative_intent` 字段写这一句。

### 原则 2：颜色绑定语义而非数据顺序

错的做法：`colors = ['blue', 'orange', 'green', 'red']` 按数据顺序分配。
对的做法：`BN → 蓝色（始终）`、`non-BN → 橙色（始终）`、`collapse/danger → vermillion (#D55E00)`、`safe/baseline → blue (#0072B2)`。

整篇论文 6 张图，BN 永远蓝、collapse 永远红——零认知负担，读者一眼建立映射。

### 原则 3：信息层级用 visual variable 表达

数据的"质量"和"分类"应该可见，不应该藏在 caption 里：

| 信息 | Visual 表达 |
|------|------------|
| n < 50 低置信度点 | hollow marker + 标注 `n=` |
| Out-of-sample / pending 数据 | hollow + 不同 marker shape（如 diamond）+ "OOS" label |
| Collapse / 异常类别 | hatching（斜线填充）|
| 主结果 vs 次要结果 | 主用饱和色，次要用 muted 色或 alpha |

### 原则 4：加叙事层，不只画数据

数据是图的基础，叙事层是让读者"读懂"的关键。常见叙事层：

- **Background bands** — `axhspan/axvspan` 标定性区域（"collapse zone"、"safe zone"、"Regime A/B/C"）
- **Fill_between** — 显示两条曲线发散区域（alpha 极低如 0.06，不抢眼但有面积）
- **Reference lines** — 锚定真实值（如 dashed line 标"actual W3A16 accuracy"）
- **Equivalence band** — `axvspan` gradient fade 标 +/-1pp 等价区间
- **Concept curve** — 完全合成的曲线（如 cosine trajectory）建立理论直觉

这些都不来自数据，但帮读者"看到"数据想说什么。

### 原则 5：Subtitle / panel label 写 insight 不写描述

错：`"Layer 6 comparison across three models"`
对：`"Same relative position, opposite function"`

错：`"Reliability diagram"`
对：`"Quantization shifts confidence but not accuracy"`

副标题是免费的 takeaway，不要浪费。

### 原则 6：Multi-panel 每个面板独立回答一个 sub-question

不要做"主图 + 装饰小图"。每个 panel 必须有独立的信息价值。

如果一个 panel 想不出独立的问题，要么删掉，要么合并到主 panel。

布局上：非对称比例（如 1.4:1）让视觉重心对齐叙事重心。

### 原则 7：Hero figure 默认要 2-3 轮迭代

第一版画出来基本不能直接用。计划好预算：先确定数据和布局，再调样式标注，最后 polish。不要指望一次到位。

---

## L3 Pattern 库（按 `design_notes` 选用）

按"图要回答的问题"选 pattern。每个 pattern 给出**何时用**、**怎么用**（具体代码或 matplotlib API）。

### Pattern A：定性区域 / regime bands

**何时用**：x 或 y 轴有自然分段（regime、phase、severity tier）。

```python
# horizontal bands
for lo, hi, color, label in [(0, 1, '#EBF5FB', 'Regime A'), (1, 5, '#EAFAF1', 'Regime B')]:
    ax.axhspan(lo, hi, alpha=0.25, color=color, zorder=0)
    ax.text(x_label_pos, (lo+hi)/2, label, va='center', fontsize=9, color='gray')

# 单一 collapse zone
ax.axhspan(-5, 5, color='#FDEDEC', alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
ax.text(0.02, 2.5, 'collapse zone', fontsize=8, color='#ccaaaa', fontstyle='italic')
```

### Pattern B：发散面积 fill_between

**何时用**：两组数据从某点开始发散，想让"发散程度"可见。

```python
# alpha 0.06 极淡，不抢眼但有面积
ax.fill_between(x_range, curve_high, curve_low, alpha=0.06, color='#555555', zorder=1)
```

### Pattern C：参考线锚定真实值

**何时用**：合成 / 缩放后的 x 轴需要锚定到真实物理量。

```python
ax.axhline(y=actual_value, color=color, linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.3)
t = ax.text(x_pos, actual_value+1, 'actual W3A16', fontsize=7, color=color, alpha=0.5)
t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])  # 防遮挡
```

### Pattern D：信息层级 marker（hollow vs solid）

**何时用**：同一图中有不同置信度 / OOS / pending 数据。

```python
# 实心 = n >= 50, 空心 = n < 50
if n < 50:
    ax.plot(x, y, marker='o', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor=color,
            markeredgewidth=1.2, markersize=6)
    ax.annotate(f'n={n}', (x, y), xytext=(0, 7), textcoords='offset points',
                fontsize=5, color=color, fontstyle='italic')
```

### Pattern E：Wilson CI / bootstrap 不确定性

**何时用**：accuracy / proportion 数据需要置信区间。

```python
def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)
```

### Pattern F：Per-label offset dict（解决标注重叠）

**何时用**：scatter 上多个点需要标注且自动布局重叠。

```python
label_offsets = {
    'Qwen3-8B':  (6, -12),   # 向下避让
    'Qwen3-4B':  (-55, 4),   # 向左避让
    'Llama-8B':  (6, 6),
}
for name, (x, y) in data.items():
    ox, oy = label_offsets.get(name, (6, 6))
    ax.annotate(name, (x, y), xytext=(ox, oy), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=7)
```

### Pattern G：Hatching 加分类维度

**何时用**：已用颜色表示一个维度，再加一个二元维度（如 collapse vs not）。

```python
for is_collapse, bar in zip(collapse_flags, bars):
    if is_collapse:
        bar.set_hatch('///')
        bar.set_alpha(0.7)
```

### Pattern H：Multi-panel 非对称布局

**何时用**：主图 + 辅助 panel；或两个等重要 panel 但视觉重心需要倾斜。

```python
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.5, 3.2),
                          gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.4, 1]})
# 主面板 1.4x 宽，副面板 1x；视觉重心在左
```

### Pattern I：Broken axis（异常值或对数 0）

**何时用**：数据范围跨度大，或对数轴需要表示 0。

```python
d = 0.012
kwargs = dict(transform=ax.transAxes, color='black', clip_on=False, linewidth=0.6)
ax.plot((1-d, 1+d), (-d, +d), **kwargs)  # 右下角斜线
ax.plot((1-d, 1+d), (1-d, 1+d), **kwargs)  # 右上角斜线
```

### Pattern J：Path-effect 文字描边

**何时用**：标注必须放在数据点 / colored region 上方。

```python
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
t = ax.text(x, y, 'label', fontsize=8, color='red')
t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])
```

### Pattern K：Concept curve（建立直觉）

**何时用**：论文核心 claim 是定性现象，需要先让读者理解理论预期。

```python
# 完全合成的 cosine trajectory，不是实验数据
x = np.linspace(0, 1, 100)
trajectory = baseline * (1 - np.cos(np.pi * x)) / 2
ax.plot(x, trajectory, linewidth=2, solid_capstyle='round')
ax.annotate('gap eliminated', (1.0, final_y), color='#388E3C',
            fontstyle='italic', fontsize=9)
```

### Pattern L：Forest plot（meta-analysis 风格）

**何时用**：多个子条件的 effect size + CI 对比，加 inline 统计数字。

3-column GridSpec：(1) 标签 (2) CI 区间图 (3) 统计数字（mean, CI, p-value）

每行：dot + horizontal line(CI) + 数字 inline。等价带用半透明 axvspan。

## L4 工具路由 + 模板

### 路由规则

| 场景 | 工具 | 原因 |
|------|------|------|
| 概念图（架构图、流程图、framework 示意） | **PaperBanana（Gemini）** | matplotlib 不擅长 |
| 统计图（scatter、bar、line、heatmap、forest） | **matplotlib** | 确定性、可控 |
| 探索性图，不确定 layout | **PaperBanana** | LLM 多轮迭代试 |
| 离线 / 无 GOOGLE_API_KEY | **matplotlib** | 不依赖外部 API |

项目级偏好：`config/projects/{name}.yaml` 的 `visualization.preferred_tool` 可覆盖。

### Matplotlib 通用样式（rcParams 标准）

```python
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11, 'axes.titlesize': 13, 'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10, 'ytick.labelsize': 10, 'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300, 'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight', 'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False, 'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42, 'ps.fonttype': 42,  # TrueType 嵌入
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# 色盲友好语义色板（Okabe-Ito）
SEMANTIC_COLORS = {
    'baseline':   '#0072B2',  # blue - safe / mild
    'treatment':  '#E69F00',  # orange - intervention
    'collapse':   '#D55E00',  # vermillion - danger / catastrophic
    'safe':       '#009E73',  # green - good outcome
    'neutral':    '#999999',  # gray - reference / control
}
```

### 常用模板（仅作起点，需按 narrative_intent 改造）

详细执行模板见 `skills/global/draw-paper-figure.skill.md`：
- Reliability Diagram（校准图）
- ECE Heatmap（方法 × 数据集 ΔECE）
- T* Scatter Plot（任务 Regime 可视化）

**重要**：这些模板是起点不是终点。每张图根据 `narrative_intent` 必须加 L3 中的相关 pattern，不能直接套用。

### 主图（Figure 1）特别提示

大多数 ML 论文的 Figure 1 是概念图/架构图/方法概览——正是 PaperBanana 的强项。除非 Figure 1 是纯数值结果对比（如 Pareto frontier），否则优先用 PaperBanana。Figure 1 的 `narrative_intent` 必须与 `writing_plan.yaml` 的 `meta.core_claim` 直接关联。

### PaperBanana 用法

见 `skills/global/paper-banana.skill.md`。意图描述时直接引用 `narrative_intent`，并把 L3 中的 pattern 名写进 intent（如 "with collapse zone background band, hollow markers for n<50"）。

---

## 给 Paper Agent 的填写规则

规划 `visualization_plan` 时，对每张图填：

```yaml
- fig_id: fig2_main_result
  type: statistical
  tool: matplotlib
  data_source: "registry: exp_001, exp_002"
  placement: experiments

  # 新字段（必填）
  narrative_intent: "Quantized models match FP16 on accuracy but degrade calibration; ECE gap widens with bits→2."
  design_notes:
    - "Pattern A: regime bands for bits=8/4/3"
    - "Pattern C: dashed line for FP16 ECE baseline"
    - "Pattern D: hollow markers for n<50 data points"

  aspect_ratio: "4:3"
```

`narrative_intent`：一句话，主动语态，描述读者应该相信的事。

`design_notes`：从 L3 选 0-4 个 pattern，给出选用理由。可以为空（说明默认模板足够）。

---

## 提交前 Checklist

L1 部分（防丑底线）：
- [ ] 所有轴有 label + 单位
- [ ] 无 dual y-axis、无 3D、无 pie
- [ ] 颜色绑定语义、色盲友好
- [ ] Bar chart 从 0 起（如有）
- [ ] 字号 ≥ 10pt（缩到 column width 后仍可读）
- [ ] PDF 矢量、300 DPI

L2 部分（叙事强度）：
- [ ] 能用一句话写出 figure takeaway（应等于 `narrative_intent`）
- [ ] Subtitle / panel label 是 insight，不是描述
- [ ] 数据质量差异在视觉上可见（n、OOS、pending 等）
- [ ] 至少考虑过是否需要 background band / fill_between / reference line（不一定要加）

This strengthens the D-study \\\"need ~10 models for G≥0.90\\\" prediction.\\n\\n## Story Spine\\n\\n**Problem**: When LLM evaluation results vary across reproductions, practitioners cannot determine whether the culprit is prompt phrasing, random seed, GPU hardware, numerical precision, temperature, or item selection — let alone how these factors interact. Every prior study isolates at most two sources, implicitly assuming separability.\\n\\n**Existing approaches & gaps**: Bouthillier et al. (2021) decomposed ML benchmark variance across hyperparameters, data splits, and seeds via ANOVA, establishing the template for factorial variance decomposition in ML evaluation. Mesting (2026) adapted G-theory to 5 methodological facets in LLM evaluation but treated infrastructure as fixed. Yuan et al. (2025) documented up to 9% accuracy variation from hardware/precision without factorial attribution. Brittlebench (2026) quantified prompt sensitivity at 50% variance on fixed hardware. IRT-based approaches (Lalor et al. 2019; Rodriguez et al. 2021; Polo et al. 2024) have analyzed item-level properties and efficient subsampling, but from a different methodological perspective than G-theory. No study has: (a) crossed infrastructure and methodology in a unified G-theory framework, (b) compared variance structure across multiple benchmarks, or (c) provided metric-conditional reproducibility budgets.\\n\\n**Our framing**: We conduct a multi-benchmark G-theory study crossing infrastructure (numerical precision) × methodology (prompt, seed, temperature, ordering) × measurement (item) factors, with model treated as a crossed facet. The infrastructure crossing yields a confirmatory null result: aggregate separability holds. The primary novel finding is a **qualitative structural shift** in variance between MC and free-form benchmarks: MC tasks (ARC/HellaSwag/MMLU) are dominated by item difficulty (42-49%) with negligible prompt/model main effects; free-form reasoning tasks (GSM8K/MATH) show fundamentally different structure where model ability (15%), prompt wording (12%), and model×prompt interaction (9%) emerge as major sources — not because items matter less in absolute terms, but because new variance sources inflate the total. This means GSM8K/MATH evaluations are far more sensitive to experimental conditions than MC benchmarks, requiring different reproducibility budgets. ## Target Venue
- Primary: AAAI 2027 (abstract Jul 21, paper Jul 28 — 9 weeks from today)
- Backup: ACL 2027 via ARR (October 15 cycle — 21 weeks)
- Extended: TACL (rolling)

## Title
Reproducibility Budgets for LLM Evaluation: A Generalizability Theory Analysis of Variance Sources Across Benchmarks, Models, and Evaluation Metrics

## Core Claims (3 条，可证伪)

**Claim 1 — Format-Conditional Variance Structure**: LLM evaluation variance structure is fundamentally format-conditional. Knowledge-retrieval MC benchmarks (MMLU, ARC, HellaSwag) show item-dominated variance (42-49% item_id, 32-38% model:item), with negligible prompt/model main effects (<1%). Free-form reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH) show qualitatively different structure: model ability (15%), prompt wording (12%), and model×prompt (9%) emerge as major variance sources — not because items matter less in absolute terms (σ²_item comparable), but because new sources inflate total variance. This format dichotomy means MC and free-form benchmarks require fundamentally different reproducibility strategies.
**Cross-model finding (exp-001)**: Item_id drops from 61% (single-model) to 42% (cross-model) as model×item (34%) absorbs model-conditional difficulty. Item difficulty rankings are model-specific — single-model G-studies overestimate item dominance by conflating universal and model-specific difficulty.
**Cross-benchmark finding (exp-002, 921,600 records)**: MC benchmarks internally consistent (item_id 42-49%, no monotonic order within MC), GSM8K qualitatively different (item_id 12%, model 15%, prompt 12%). The structural shift is between evaluation formats, not along a continuous complexity gradient.
**Empirical anchors (exp-001, 4 models, balanced bf16, 345,600 records)**: Single-model item_id=61.1%, cross-model item_id=42.1% [36.0-48.8%] (↓19pp), model×item=33.6% [28.4-37.9%] (second-largest source, increased from 3-model 31.7%). G_item=0.820 [0.782-0.861]. D-study prediction validated out-of-sample: 3-model predicted G=0.816 for n=4, actual=0.820 (Δ=0.004). Forward projection: 5 models → G=0.848, 8→0.893, 10→0.910 (G≥0.90 requires ~10 models). Residual dropped 24%→19.5% as 4th model split residual into model×item. Per-model interaction: Mistral 29.25% (lowest accuracy 63.8%) > Qwen 27.11% > Gemma 23.95% > Llama 19.69%.
**REML robustness**: REML-EM (500 iter, practical convergence Δ<0.003pp) confirms Henderson I: all components differ <0.5pp. Henderson I unbiased for balanced designs. Dataset B differences (item_id 38→52%, model×item 26→12%) due to design differences (factor selection), not estimator bias — measurement design choices themselves affect observed variance structure.
**Completed robustness**: BF16-vs-FP16 sensitivity confirms precision→0.0006% without FP32 (FP32 is sole source of precision variance); leave-one-model-out (matched-spec) shows G_item range 0.747-0.793 across 3-model subsets (spread=0.046) — all below 0.80, confirming 4 models is the minimum for reliable cross-model measurement. LOMO also confirms item_id dominance and model×item as second-largest source are stable across all subsets.
**GLMM cross-check (dual-analysis, must report both)**: Two complementary analyses:
(i) *Marginal logit ANOVA*: All 7 grouped component rankings preserved exactly (ρ=1.0), consistent with MQL-1 prediction that logit-scaling is approximately constant at p̄=0.70.
(ii) *VB GLMM (25-item subsample)*: Ranking reversal on top-2 — model:item_id=47.3% > item_id=22.8% on logit scale (ρ=0.571, p=0.18). Attributable to model underspecification (missing 4 item-interaction terms in VB model) + subsample.
**Paper must present BOTH honestly** — "marginal logit ANOVA preserves all rankings; VB GLMM shows differences attributable to model underspecification." Do NOT overwrite ρ=0.571 with ρ=1.0. Implication: model×item interaction may be even more important than Henderson I indicates on logit scale — strengthens Claim 1's core message.

**Claim 2 — Conditional Separability**: Infrastructure factors (numerical precision) and methodology factors (prompt, seed, temperature, ordering) are approximately separable at the aggregate level — direct infrastructure×methodology interaction ≈0% under binary scoring; the only detectable cross-factor interaction (precision×temperature=1.3%) emerges under text-exact-match scoring, consistent with floating-point non-associativity (Messina & Scotta, 2026). Both factor types interact substantially with item difficulty (precision×item, prompt×item), making their effects item-conditional. This provides a metric-qualified confirmatory finding for isolated-factor studies while warning that conclusions are conditional on item selection and evaluation metric. Note: with only numerical precision tested on a single GPU architecture (pending exp-003 for hardware crossing), "infrastructure" is currently limited to the precision facet.

**Claim 3 — Design-Dependent Reproducibility Budget**: Reproducibility budgets are fundamentally design-dependent, metric-conditional, and temperature-conditional. The critical insight: the number of items needed for reliable measurement depends dramatically on how many evaluation conditions you use.
- **Multi-facet design** (6 prompts × 6 seeds × 3 temps × 4 orderings = 432 conditions/item): G=0.918 at 200 items, G≥0.80 at only **72 items**. The 432-condition averaging reduces per-item error variance by 8.86×.
- **Single-condition evaluation** (1×1×1×1, typical practice): G=0.559 at 200 items, G≥0.80 requires **631 items**. Residual absorbs 53.5% of error variance with no averaging.
- **IRT's 116-item recommendation** yields G=0.424 under single-condition — far below the 0.80 reliability threshold. IRT ignores prompt, seed, and ordering facets entirely.
- Text-exact-match: G=0.007 (temperature dominates at 79.7%), unreliable at any temperature >0.
The 8.8× efficiency gap between multi-facet (72 items) and single-condition (631 items) is the core practical contribution: G-theory shows that **investing in evaluation conditions is more efficient than adding items** when prompt/seed/ordering facets contribute substantial variance.

## Contributions (4 条，明确区分)

1. **Model×item interaction as the hidden dominant source**: In a balanced 4-model design (345,600 records), model×item interaction (33.6%, CI [28.4-37.9%]) is the second-largest variance source, while item_id drops from 61% (single-model) to 42%. Item difficulty rankings are model-specific — single-model G-studies overestimate item dominance by conflating universal and model-specific difficulty. G_item=0.820 [0.782-0.861] with 4 models; D-study prediction validated out-of-sample (3-model predicted 0.816, actual 0.820, Δ=0.004). Reaching G≥0.90 requires ~10 models. [Note: position as quantification of a phenomenon expected from measurement theory, not as a surprising discovery. The novelty is the magnitude, the out-of-sample D-study validation, and the cross-model generalizability implications.]

2. **Precision separability with metric qualification**: Precision×methodology interactions are negligible under binary scoring (<0.1%), providing empirical support for isolated-factor studies. Under text-exact-match scoring, precision×temperature reaches 4.15%, consistent with floating-point non-associativity. Separability is confirmed as metric-conditional. [Note: scope to "numerical precision on single GPU architecture" — not "infrastructure" broadly. This is a confirmatory secondary finding, not a primary contribution. Pending BF16-vs-FP16 sensitivity to isolate FP32/vLLM confound.]

3. **IRT vs G-theory: the design-dependent reliability gap**: The first empirical quantification of how evaluation design choices affect measurement reliability. Single-condition evaluation (typical practice) requires **631 items** for G≥0.80; IRT's recommended 116 items yields only G=0.424 — far below reliable. A multi-facet design (6 prompts × 6 seeds × 3 temps × 4 orderings) reduces this to **72 items** — an **8.8× efficiency gain** from condition averaging. G-theory's D-study reveals this tradeoff explicitly: investing in evaluation conditions is more efficient than adding items. IRT cannot model this tradeoff because it ignores prompt/seed/ordering facets. The practical implication: current evaluation practices (1 prompt, 1 seed, ~200 items) achieve G=0.559 — the field is in a reliability gap it cannot see without multi-facet analysis. [Note: keep as numbered contribution. The corrected G_item formula (M015) strengthens the contribution: the 8.8× design efficiency gap is a stronger finding than the original 3.6-4.4× item ratio.]

4. **Practitioner toolkit**: Open-source G-theory variance decomposition pipeline + D-study budget calculator for LLM evaluation. Includes: (a) benchmark-specific reproducibility budget tables (items × prompts × seeds for target G), (b) temperature-stratified reliability guide, (c) model-as-facet analysis template. Addresses "purely diagnostic" criticism — provides actionable tools, not just warnings.

## Methodological Robustness Package (6 验证分析)
All completed on Llama 239,200 records:
- **Binary data not artifact**: Null simulation item_id=0.08% vs observed 61.1% (737.5×); obs/Bernoulli ratio=1.0008
- **Fixed vs random insensitive**: G_item difference only 0.37pp (all-random 0.820 vs fixed temp+ordering 0.824); facet classification near-insensitive
- **Bootstrap = jackknife**: CI width ratio 0.96-1.04, independence violation negligible
- **Temperature stratification**: Binary G degrades T=0.0 (0.760) → T=0.7 (0.549); text metric unreliable at all T>0
- **D-study formula verified (corrected M015)**: Multi-facet min_items_G80=72, single-condition min_items_G80=631, ratio ~8.8×. **Progressive validation**: absolute min_items grows linearly with sample size (CV 18%), BUT the multi/single ratio is highly stable: 8.55→8.84→8.92→8.86 across subset sizes 50-200 (CV 1.9%). G_item also converged (0.918-0.922, CV<0.2%). **Paper should report "~8.8× efficiency gain" (stable ratio) rather than absolute item counts.** Absolute values noted as sample-size dependent in Discussion.
- **IRT comparison (recalculated)**: IRT's 116 items → G=0.424 under single-condition (insufficient). Single-condition G-theory needs 631 items (5.4× IRT). Multi-facet G-theory needs only 72 items (0.62× IRT). The gap quantifies the value of multi-facet design.
- **REML vs Henderson I**: REML-EM (500 iter) confirms all components within <0.5pp of Henderson I; Henderson I unbiased for balanced designs
- **D-study uncertainty propagation [Dream A2, TODO]**: Propagate bootstrap CIs on variance components into confidence intervals on D-study budget recommendations (min_items_G80). Currently only point estimates reported; practitioners need uncertainty ranges.
- **Intermediate D-study recommendations [Dream A3, TODO]**: Show what partial improvements buy: "2 prompts × 2 seeds on 200 items → G≈X" to make framework adoptable. Address "20-50× cost" concern from Dream reviewers.
- **BF16-vs-FP16 sensitivity**: Excluding FP32, precision effect drops from 0.4% to 0.0006% (precision×item: 1.3%→0.04%). FP32 anomaly is entirely a vLLM enforce_eager artifact, not a fundamental precision effect. BF16≈FP16 (Δ=0.23pp accuracy)
- **Leave-one-model-out stability**: All 3-model subsets preserve item_id dominance (39-45%) and model×item as second-largest (32-37%). G_item range 0.747-0.793 (spread=0.046), all below 0.80 — confirming 4 models is the minimum configuration for G≥0.80. This strengthens the D-study "need ~10 models for G≥0.90" prediction.

## Story Spine

**Problem**: When LLM evaluation results vary across reproductions, practitioners cannot determine whether the culprit is prompt phrasing, random seed, GPU hardware, numerical precision, temperature, or item selection — let alone how these factors interact. Every prior study isolates at most two sources, implicitly assuming separability.

**Existing approaches & gaps**: Bouthillier et al. (2021) decomposed ML benchmark variance across hyperparameters, data splits, and seeds via ANOVA, establishing the template for factorial variance decomposition in ML evaluation. Mesting (2026) adapted G-theory to 5 methodological facets in LLM evaluation but treated infrastructure as fixed. Yuan et al. (2025) documented up to 9% accuracy variation from hardware/precision without factorial attribution. Brittlebench (2026) quantified prompt sensitivity at 50% variance on fixed hardware. IRT-based approaches (Lalor et al. 2019; Rodriguez et al. 2021; Polo et al. 2024) have analyzed item-level properties and efficient subsampling, but from a different methodological perspective than G-theory. No study has: (a) crossed infrastructure and methodology in a unified G-theory framework, (b) compared variance structure across multiple benchmarks, or (c) provided metric-conditional reproducibility budgets.

**Our framing**: We conduct a multi-benchmark G-theory study crossing infrastructure (numerical precision) × methodology (prompt, seed, temperature, ordering) × measurement (item) factors, with model treated as a crossed facet. The infrastructure crossing yields a confirmatory null result: aggregate separability holds. The primary novel finding is a **qualitative structural shift** in variance between MC and free-form benchmarks: MC tasks (ARC/HellaSwag/MMLU) are dominated by item difficulty (42-49%) with negligible prompt/model main effects; free-form reasoning tasks (GSM8K/MATH) show fundamentally different structure where model ability (15%), prompt wording (12%), and model×prompt interaction (9%) emerge as major sources — not because items matter less in absolute terms, but because new variance sources inflate the total. This means GSM8K/MATH evaluations are far more sensitive to experimental conditions than MC benchmarks, requiring different reproducibility budgets. D-study projections provide the first benchmark-specific, design-dependent reproducibility budgets, revealing an 8.8× efficiency gap between multi-facet and single-condition designs.

**Headline result template**: "In a G-study of 345,600 evaluation records across 4 models on MMLU (200 items × 6 prompts × 6 seeds × 3 temperatures × 4 orderings), item selection accounts for 42% of variance when model is treated as a crossed facet — but model×item interaction (34%) emerges as the second-largest source, revealing that item difficulty rankings are substantially model-specific (G_item=0.82, requiring ~10 models for G≥0.90). D-study projections reveal an 8.8× design efficiency gap: a multi-facet design needs only 72 items for G≥0.80, while single-condition evaluation needs 631 items — IRT's recommended 116 items yields only G=0.42 under typical practice. Investing in evaluation conditions (multiple prompts, seeds) is more efficient than adding items. Numerical precision×methodology interactions are negligible under binary scoring (<0.1%). We release an open-source G-theory pipeline and D-study budget calculator."

## Hook (Counter-Intuitive Quantified Claim)
"Multiple-choice and free-form LLM benchmarks have fundamentally different variance structures: on MC tasks, item selection drives 42-49% of variance while prompt wording is negligible; on reasoning tasks like GSM8K, prompt wording alone accounts for 12% of variance — more than item selection. A reproducibility budget designed for MMLU will systematically undercount the sources that matter for GSM8K, and vice versa."

## Narrative Strategy
- **Type**: Cross-domain transfer (psychometrics G-theory → ML evaluation) + Empirical contribution (benchmark-conditional gradient)
- **Tension**: "No universal recipe" — the field seeks standardization but variance structure varies qualitatively across task types
- **Intro structure**: 4 paragraphs + 3 contributions (field mode from distilled writing patterns)
- **Signature visual**: Stacked-bar variance decomposition chart across benchmarks (field idiom from Mesting/Brittlebench)

  2. **G-theory crossed design diagram** — facets, levels, crossing structure
  3. **D-study projection curves** — G vs item count for binary (practical vs all-random) and text metric. Shows G≥0.80 threshold at ~414/510 items.
  4. **IRT vs G-theory item requirement comparison** — bar chart showing 116 (IRT) vs 510 (G-theory) items, with breakdown of where the extra items go (prompt×item, seed×item, residual)

  - Item dominance acknowledged as **psychometrically expected**; contribution is quantification + benchmark gradient

MC benchmarks (ARC 49%, HellaSwag 45%, MMLU 42%) show high item dominance; GSM8K (12%) shows qualitative shift where model main effect (15%) and prompt_template (12%) emerge as major sources. The story is "variance structure itself changes qualitatively between MC and free-form tasks" rather than "item_id monotonically decreases." model:item% also doesn't monotonically increase (GSM8K 12% < MC 32-38%). Must use absolute variance values alongside percentages to avoid denominator-inflation artifacts. Permutation test p=1/120 but observed pattern NOT monotonic — test statistic methodology needs careful description
  - "Fully crossed" language qualified to MMLU exp-001 only; other benchmarks use reduced designs

**Defense strategy (upgraded per Round 1 MF1 + Reviewer + GLMM results)**: Four-line defense, reordered by strength:
(a) **PRIMARY — Simulation-based recovery** ✅ DONE (matched design verified): Probit latent model → binary, 100 replications × {50,100,200} items × {0.5-0.8} accuracy. **Strongest finding (matched 1,296-condition design): binary ρ=0.732 ≈ continuous ρ=0.741 at n=200 (Δ=0.009) — binary binarization adds NO ranking distortion beyond what continuous data already has.** Henderson I identifies item_id as #1 systematic source in 99-100% of runs. Top-3/top-5 accuracy weaker (55-76% / 58-82%) — do NOT claim "ranking recovery equivalent", instead: "robustly identifies dominant source; smaller component ordering comparable between binary and continuous." **Paper must discuss**: (i) residual inflation (latent 16%→~40%, Bernoulli within-cell variance); (ii) "no-residual" Spearman is correct metric; (iii) CI coverage slightly anti-conservative at high accuracy (86.4% at p=0.8).
(b) **COMPLEMENTARY — GLMM logistic-link**: GLMM (Jiang & Skorupski 2017) on 25-item MMLU subsample showed **ranking reversal**: model:item_id #1 (47.3%) > item_id #2 (22.8%) on logit scale, vs Henderson I item_id #1 (42.1%) > model:item_id #2 (33.6%). Spearman ρ=0.571, p=0.18 — rankings NOT statistically consistent. BUT: macro-level agreement holds (item-related >> condition effects in both). Reversal is theoretically expected — logit link amplifies DIF (differential item functioning) for extreme-difficulty items. **Paper framing**: "Henderson I and GLMM agree on macro structure; differ on item_id vs model:item_id ordering due to scale properties of logit link. This is a complementary perspective, not a contradiction. GLMM suggests model:item interaction may be even more dominant than Henderson I indicates." Do NOT claim GLMM "validates" Henderson I.
(c) **Bernoulli-adjusted decomposition**: ✅ DONE. Percentage decomposition inherently normalized by p(1-p) ceiling. Per-model adjustment preserved interaction gradient (Mistral rank drops from #1→#3 but interaction still substantial). Cross-accuracy resampling (0.62-0.72) shows item_id% stable (r=-0.048 with accuracy).
(d) **Logprob robustness check**: Continuous metric analysis showing gradient preserved — bypasses binary assumption entirely.
(e) **Methods subsection**: "Binary Data Assumptions" discussing Henderson I bias properties for balanced designs, citing Brennan Ch.12, Shavelson et al. 1989, Mushquash & O'Connor 2006, Lalor et al. 2019 (IRT on binary NLP data). Must note GLMM residual drops to 0.004% as Bernoulli variance absorbed by link function.

### MD2. Fixed vs Random Facet Sensitivity
**Issue**: Temperature (2-3 design points) and ordering (4 systematic rotations) are not randomly sampled from a universe — treating them as random facets may be inappropriate.
**Defense ✅ DONE**: All-random G_item=0.820 vs fixed(temp+ordering) G_item=0.824, difference only **0.37pp**. Delta decreases 2.47% when fixing temp+ordering — temperature:item (0.65%) and ordering:item (0.54%) are small enough that fixing these facets barely changes the G coefficient. **Random facet assumption is robust.** REML vs Henderson I comparison also shows <0.5pp difference on all components, confirming estimator choice is insensitive for balanced designs.

### MD3. Separability Claim Scope
**Issue**: Separability (<0.3%) holds for knowledge benchmarks but not reasoning tasks (GSM8K=3.0%, MATH=2.5%).
**Defense**: Qualify all separability claims as "under binary scoring on knowledge-retrieval benchmarks." Present benchmark-conditional separability as a finding (not a limitation): "separability itself varies across task types."

### MD4. D-study Optimization Documentation
**Issue**: Optimization procedure undocumented; Table 10 arithmetic anomaly (fewer items → higher G).
**Defense**: Document grid search procedure (bounds, step sizes, objective function). Verify and explain any non-monotonicity (likely due to joint optimization across facets where reallocating item budget to prompt/seed is more efficient).

### MD5. G-coefficient Interpretation
**Issue**: G=0.22 for 200 items ≠ "MMLU is unreliable" (standard MMLU uses ~14K items).
**Defense**: (a) Clearly distinguish "G for our 200-item subsample design" from "reliability of full MMLU"; (b) Report D-study projection to 14K items; (c) Frame G=0.22 as "cost of subsampling" rather than "MMLU is broken."

**Issue**: Item-level bootstrap with replacement creates ~127 unique items per 200-item resample, violating independence.
**Defense**: (a) Implement delete-1 jackknife as comparison; (b) If bootstrap and jackknife CIs are similar (within 20%), report as robust; (c) Discuss limitation in Methods.

### MD7. IRT vs G-theory Comparison
**Issue**: tinyBenchmarks recommends ~100 items, D-study recommends 420. 4× discrepancy unexplained.
**Defense**: Direct comparison showing G-theory accounts for prompt/seed/ordering dimensions that IRT ignores. The 4× difference is the "cost of multi-facet reliability" — G-theory's budget is larger because it targets reliability across ALL facets, not just items. This comparison is a potential standalone contribution.

### MD8. Cross-benchmark Design Asymmetry
**Issue**: MMLU uses 3 prec × 3 temp, other benchmarks use 2 × 2.
**Defense**: Re-analyze MMLU with matched 2×2 design (bf16/fp16 × T=0.0/T=0.7) and compare variance decomposition. If <5% change, report as robust to design reduction.

1	"""Per-benchmark Henderson I variance decomposition for exp-002.
2	
3	Input:  Merged exp-002 JSONL (4 models x 4 benchmarks x bf16 x 2 temps x 6 prompts x 6 seeds x 4 orderings).
4	Output: results/analysis/exp002_per_benchmark_gstudy.json
5	        — per-benchmark variance components, G_item, D-study projections.
6	
7	Facets (7, within each benchmark):
8	  model, temperature, prompt_template, seed, ordering, item_id
9	  + all 2-way interactions. Residual absorbs >=3-way.
10	
11	Usage:
12	  python scripts/exp002_analysis/per_benchmark_gstudy.py --data-dir results/exp002
13	"""
14	
15	import argparse
16	import json
17	import sys
18	import time
19	from itertools import combinations
20	from math import prod
21	from pathlib import Path
22	
23	import numpy as np
24	import pandas as pd
25	
26	sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
27	from src.config.model_paths import normalize_model_name
28	
29	FACETS = ["model", "temperature", "prompt_template", "seed", "ordering", "item_id"]
30	BENCHMARKS = ["mmlu", "gsm8k", "arc", "hellaswag"]
31	
32	
33	def load_exp002_data(data_dir: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
34	    data_path = Path(data_dir)
35	    jsonl_files = sorted(data_path.glob("*.jsonl"))
36	    if not jsonl_files:
37	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No JSONL files in {data_dir}")
38	    frames = [pd.read_json(f, lines=True) for f in jsonl_files]
39	    df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
40	    if "top_logprobs" in df.columns:
41	        df.drop(columns=["top_logprobs"], inplace=True)
42	    df["model"] = df["model"].map(normalize_model_name).fillna(df["model"])
43	    for f in FACETS:
44	        df[f] = df[f].astype(str)
45	    return df
46	
47	
48	def compute_henderson_i(df: pd.DataFrame, response: str, facets: list[str]):
49	    """Henderson Method I: SS -> EMS -> variance components."""
50	    grand_mean = df[response].mean()
51	    N = len(df)
52	    n_levels = {f: df[f].nunique() for f in facets}
53	
54	    effects = {}
55	
56	    for f in facets:
57	        group_means = df.groupby(f, observed=True)[response].mean()
58	        n_per = N // n_levels[f]
59	        ss = float(n_per * ((group_means - grand_mean) ** 2).sum())
60	        df_eff = n_levels[f] - 1
61	        effects[f] = {"ss": ss, "df": df_eff, "ms": ss / df_eff if df_eff > 0 else 0.0}
62	
63	    for fi, fj in combinations(facets, 2):
64	        cell_means = df.groupby([fi, fj], observed=True)[response].mean()
65	        main_fi = df.groupby(fi, observed=True)[response].mean()
66	        main_fj = df.groupby(fj, observed=True)[response].mean()
67	        n_per = N // (n_levels[fi] * n_levels[fj])
68	        ss = 0.0
69	        for (li, lj), cm in cell_means.items():
70	            interaction = cm - main_fi[li] - main_fj[lj] + grand_mean
71	            ss += n_per * interaction ** 2
72	        df_eff = (n_levels[fi] - 1) * (n_levels[fj] - 1)
73	        effects[f"{fi}:{fj}"] = {"ss": ss, "df": df_eff, "ms": ss / df_eff if df_eff > 0 else 0.0}
74	
75	    ss_total = float(((df[response] - grand_mean) ** 2).sum())
76	    ss_model = sum(e["ss"] for e in effects.values())
77	    ss_res = max(0.0, ss_total - ss_model)
78	    df_res = N - 1 - sum(e["df"] for e in effects.values())
79	    effects["residual"] = {"ss": ss_res, "df": df_res, "ms": ss_res / df_res if df_res > 0 else 0.0}
80	
81	    ms_res = effects["residual"]["ms"]
82	    vc = {}
83	    for fi, fj in combinations(facets, 2):
84	        key = f"{fi}:{fj}"
85	        coeff = prod(n_levels[f] for f in facets if f not in (fi, fj))
86	        raw = (effects[key]["ms"] - ms_res) / coeff if coeff > 0 else 0.0
87	        vc[key] = max(0.0, raw)
88	
89	    for fi in facets:
90	        coeff_main = prod(n_levels[f] for f in facets if f != fi)
91	        interaction_contrib = 0.0
92	        for fj in facets:
93	            if fj == fi:
94	                continue
95	            int_key = f"{fi}:{fj}" if f"{fi}:{fj}" in vc else f"{fj}:{fi}"
96	            coeff_ij = prod(n_levels[f] for f in facets if f not in (fi, fj))
97	            interaction_contrib += coeff_ij * vc[int_key]
98	        raw = (effects[fi]["ms"] - interaction_contrib - ms_res) / coeff_main if coeff_main > 0 else 0.0
99	        vc[fi] = max(0.0, raw)
100	
101	    vc["residual"] = ms_res
102	    return vc, n_levels, effects
103	
104	
105	def compute_g_item(vc: dict, n_levels: dict) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
106	    """G_item: object of measurement = item_id.
107	
108	    sigma_tau = sigma^2(item_id)
109	    sigma_delta = sum of X:item_id / n_X terms + residual / prod(n_X for X != item_id)
110	    """
111	    sigma_item = vc.get("item_id", 0.0)
112	    non_item_facets = [f for f in FACETS if f != "item_id"]
113	
114	    sigma_delta = 0.0
115	    for comp, est in vc.items():
116	        if est == 0.0 or comp == "item_id":
117	            continue
118	        if comp == "residual":
119	            divisor = prod(n_levels[f] for f in non_item_facets)
120	            sigma_delta += est / divisor
121	            continue
122	        facets_in = set(comp.split(":"))
123	        if "item_id" not in facets_in:
124	            continue
125	        other = [f for f in facets_in if f != "item_id"]
126	        divisor = prod(n_levels[f] for f in other) if other else 1
127	        sigma_delta += est / divisor
128	
129	    g = sigma_item / (sigma_item + sigma_delta) if (sigma_item + sigma_delta) > 0 else 0.0
130	    return g, sigma_item, sigma_delta
131	
132	
133	def d_study_curve(vc: dict, n_levels: dict, item_counts: list[int]) -> dict:
134	    """D-study: vary n_items, hold other facets at actual levels."""
135	    non_item_facets = [f for f in FACETS if f != "item_id"]
136	    sigma_item = vc.get("item_id", 0.0)
137	    n_actual = n_levels["item_id"]
138	
139	    non_item_error = 0.0
140	    for comp, est in vc.items():
141	        if est == 0.0 or comp == "item_id":
142	            continue
143	        if comp == "residual":
144	            divisor = prod(n_levels[f] for f in non_item_facets)
145	            non_item_error += est / divisor
146	            continue
147	        facets_in = set(comp.split(":"))
148	        if "item_id" not in facets_in:
149	            continue
150	        other = [f for f in facets_in if f != "item_id"]
151	        divisor = prod(n_levels[f] for f in other) if other else 1
152	        non_item_error += est / divisor
153	
154	    curve = {}
155	    for ni in item_counts:
156	        ratio = n_actual / ni
157	        sigma_delta_ni = non_item_error * ratio
158	        g_ni = sigma_item / (sigma_item + sigma_delta_ni) if (sigma_item + sigma_delta_ni) > 0 else 0.0
159	        curve[ni] = round(g_ni, 6)
160	    return curve
161	
162	
163	def find_min_items_for_g(vc: dict, n_levels: dict, target_g: float, max_items: int = 2000) -> int | None:
164	    non_item_facets = [f for f in FACETS if f != "item_id"]
165	    sigma_item = vc.get("item_id", 0.0)
166	    n_actual = n_levels["item_id"]
167	
168	    non_item_error = 0.0
169	    for comp, est in vc.items():
170	        if est == 0.0 or comp == "item_id":
171	            continue
172	        if comp == "residual":
173	            divisor = prod(n_levels[f] for f in non_item_facets)
174	            non_item_error += est / divisor
175	            continue
176	        facets_in = set(comp.split(":"))
177	        if "item_id" not in facets_in:
178	            continue
179	        other = [f for f in facets_in if f != "item_id"]
180	        divisor = prod(n_levels[f] for f in other) if other else 1
181	        non_item_error += est / divisor
182	
183	    for ni in range(1, max_items + 1):
184	        ratio = n_actual / ni
185	        sigma_delta_ni = non_item_error * ratio
186	        g = sigma_item / (sigma_item + sigma_delta_ni) if (sigma_item + sigma_delta_ni) > 0 else 0.0
187	        if g >= target_g:
188	            return ni
189	    return None
190	
191	
192	def analyze_benchmark(df_bm: pd.DataFrame, benchmark: str) -> dict:
193	    print(f"\n{'='*60}", flush=True)
194	    print(f"Benchmark: {benchmark} ({len(df_bm)} obs)", flush=True)
195	
196	    vc, n_levels, effects = compute_henderson_i(df_bm, "correct", FACETS)
197	    total_var = sum(vc.values())
198	    g_item, sigma_tau, sigma_delta = compute_g_item(vc, n_levels)
199	
200	    print(f"  G_item = {g_item:.6f}", flush=True)
201	    print(f"  item_id% = {vc.get('item_id', 0) / total_var * 100:.2f}%", flush=True)
202	    print(f"  model:item_id% = {vc.get('model:item_id', 0) / total_var * 100:.2f}%", flush=True)
203	
204	    item_counts = [25, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 300, 500, 1000]
205	    d_curve = d_study_curve(vc, n_levels, item_counts)
206	    min_80 = find_min_items_for_g(vc, n_levels, 0.80)
207	
208	    return {
209	        "benchmark": benchmark,
210	        "n_observations": len(df_bm),
211	        "n_levels": {k: int(v) for k, v in n_levels.items()},
212	        "grand_mean_accuracy": round(float(df_bm["correct"].mean()), 6),
213	        "variance_components": {
214	            k: {"estimate": round(v, 10), "pct": round(v / total_var * 100, 4) if total_var > 0 else 0.0}
215	            for k, v in sorted(vc.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])
216	        },
217	        "total_variance": round(total_var, 10),
218	        "G_item": round(g_item, 6),
219	        "sigma_tau": round(sigma_tau, 10),
220	        "sigma_delta": round(sigma_delta, 10),
221	        "d_study_curve": d_curve,
222	        "min_items_G_0.80": min_80,
223	    }
224	
225	
226	def main():
227	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Per-benchmark Henderson I G-study for exp-002")
228	    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", default="results/exp002", help="Directory containing exp-002 JSONL files")
229	    parser.add_argument("--output", default="results/analysis/exp002_per_benchmark_gstudy.json")
